caption: The drawing features a square composition filled with a geometric pattern. The primary colors used are shades of blue and orange. The design consists of a grid of smaller squares arranged in a 4x4 layout. In each of the four corners, there is a large dark blue square bordered with small orange squares, creating a checkerboard-like appearance. The central area of the pattern contains a series of interlocking rectangles and smaller squares filled with a medium blue color, with additional orange and blue woven lines throughout the background. The background behind the shapes is a lighter blue interspersed with regular orange horizontal and vertical lines, giving a textured, woven impression. The entire patterned square is framed by a simple double-line border, set against a plain off-white background. Handwritten text is visible at the bottom of the page near the border.
title: Coverlet (Reverse Side)
